summary: Email pr@ as the one action, the 2026 levels in a short compare list, and the full sponsor wall. Why: a business decides and reaches out in one screen.
blurb: Sponsor levels and perks for local businesses, plus a thank-you to our 2026 sponsors.

sources.fact: 2026 spring prices: Sleeve $250/team; Home Run $500; Team $600/team; Division $5,000 to $10,000; All Stars $2,000 (10U/11U) or $3,000 (12U/Intermediate/Juniors/Seniors); contact pr@blslittleleague.org.
2026 spring sponsorships were sold through Mar 1, 2026.
Fall Ball 2026 prices: Sleeve $150/team; Team $450/team, or $350/team for 15+ teams.

2026 spring sponsors: Los Pinos Mexican Restaurant, Grasshopper Landscaping and Construction, Molen Orthodontics, Titan Door, Ossman Harding Dental, Round Table Pizza, Cal-Line Equipment, Owen Equipment, RLS Lending, Prospect Construction, Land O'Frost, Honey Bucket, Lowe's, Sumner/Bonney Lake Jr. Panthers Wrestling Club, Enrique Trujeque Agency.
Fall Ball 2026 sponsors: Molen Orthodontics, Great Northwest Dental, Northwest Cascade.
DICK'S Sporting Goods is the league's partner for member discount weekends (20% off in store).
Molen Orthodontics and Southern Yankee Graphics were named as two of our sponsors at Opening Day 2026.
Federal Way National Little League donated infield dirt; Mowatt Trucking and CJ Hoffman moved it; Lions Community Park is housing it.
Seattle Mariners grounds crew helped with infield dirt; Sunbelt Rentals donated the dump trailer.
East Pierce Firefighters Local 3520's 2nd Annual Charity Golf Tournament (Aug 2026) benefited youth sports including BLS.
